in_marathi.name: Gautamika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gautamika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gautamika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Gautama' which means 'learned' or 'scholar'. This name is often associated with the Buddha, Gautama, who gained enlightenment through his extensive knowledge and study.
